issues.description: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and the caller formats it into the URL, producing '/latest/None/Packages'
issues.detail: When the arch regex misses, the function returns None and use_koji_url_only embeds it verbatim into the constructed URL. No exception, no log, just a malformed lockfile entry. Either raise on miss or have the caller refuse to continue. Classic defensive-None-return masquerading as correctness.

issues.description: nevra[0] uses the first character of the filename, not the first letter of the package name as koji's Packages layout requires
issues.detail: The koji /Packages/{letter}/ directory keys on the package name's first letter, lowercased. nevra[0] happens to match today because URL basenames equal NEVRA filenames, but the precondition is nowhere asserted. A digit-prefixed name, uppercase, or path-bearing basename breaks silently. Parse the package name properly.

issues.description: Race condition with coreos-koji-tagger is acknowledged in the commit message but unmitigated in code
issues.detail: The URL is fabricated before the artifact is tagged into coreos-pool. The author calls this 'safe' without stating an invariant, adding retry/verify, or even leaving an in-code comment. A future maintainer debugging a 404 will not find this in the commit log. Document the precondition in the module and consider a verify step.

issues.description: Hardcoded koji_url_base and arch list scattered across functions with no single source of truth
issues.detail: The arch list inside extract_arch_from_url is independent of arches iterated elsewhere, and the koji base URL is a string literal embedded in logic. A koji layout or arch change requires grepping multiple sites. Lift to module-level constants so the contract lives in one place.

issues.description: noarch packages are a legal arch in this domain but are unhandled by extract_arch_from_url
issues.detail: The koji canonical path /latest/{arch}/Packages applies to noarch RPMs too (filenames end in .noarch.rpm, resolved via --arch noarch), but the regex only matches four arches. A noarch URL will silently get None or pick up a misleading substring from elsewhere in the path. Add noarch to the recognized arch set.

issues.description: Stale 'Prioritize the url from fedora-coreos-pool' branch left in query_packages_location with no rationale after the new rewriter was added
issues.detail: use_koji_url_only rewrites everything downstream, making the prioritization either dead code or load-bearing for an unstated reason. Don't leave both halves of a half-finished refactor in the tree. Either remove the branch or add a comment explaining why it still matters.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The approach — synthesize the canonical koji URL rather than trust dnf5's broken baseurl — is reasonable, but two concrete defects must be fixed before merge: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and gets string-formatted into a malformed '/latest/None/Packages' URL, and the Packages/{letter} subdirectory uses nevra[0] instead of the package name's first letter, which works today only by accident. The acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger ships with no in-code mitigation or even a comment. Module-level constants and noarch handling should also be tightened. Add a unit test for the two new functions.
